stack_note: stack_net/off/def_per36, expected_minutes, value_pg, evidence carry THE TOP-100 STACK player rating (display fields, no feature token -- the value_off_per36 precedent); pricing still uses value_per36
value_off_def_note: value_off_per36/value_def_per36 (they ADD to value_per36; a POSITIVE def is GOOD defence, the opposite of the team ratings' convention) are what the receiver prices a roster edit from: a man's offence lands on his new team's offence and his defence on its defence, instead of half his net landing on each. replacement_tilt_per36 is the offence-minus-defence lean handed to anybody the model has no per-side opinion about.
